sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "halaqahs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "teacher_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "halaqah_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "center_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(teacher_name)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(halaqah_name)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(center_name)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "support_program_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "halaqah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES halaqahs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_name" TEXT NULL, "created_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("halaqah_id"), CHECK (status IN ('disabled', 'pending_activation', 'enabled')), CHECK ((status = 'disabled' AND organization_name IS NULL) OR (status IN ('pending_activation', 'enabled') AND organization_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(organization_name)) > 0)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "support_program_periods" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "halaqah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES halaqahs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "organization_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at_utc" TEXT NULL, CHECK (length(trim(organization_name)) > 0), CHECK (ended_at_utc IS NULL OR ended_at_utc > started_at_utc));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "students" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "halaqah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES halaqahs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "student_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "father_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "age_years" INTEGER NOT NULL, "guardian_country_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "guardian_national_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_memorization_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "support_student_number" TEXT NULL, "display_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at_utc" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("halaqah_id", "support_student_number"), CHECK (length(trim(student_name)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(father_name)) > 0), CHECK (guardian_country_code IN ('+967', '+966')), CHECK (length(trim(guardian_national_number)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(previous_memorization_text)) > 0), CHECK (support_student_number IS NULL OR length(trim(support_student_number)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student_progress_plans" ("student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "current_juz" INTEGER NULL, "daily_plan_text" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("student_id"), CHECK (current_juz IS NULL OR (current_juz >= 1 AND current_juz <= 30)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student_activity_periods" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "active_from_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "active_to_date" TEXT NULL, CHECK (active_to_date IS NULL OR active_to_date >= active_from_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "halaqah_days" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "halaqah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES halaqahs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "day_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("halaqah_id", "day_date"), CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closed', 'holiday')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES halaqah_days (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("day_id", "student_id"), CHECK (status IN ('present', 'absent', 'excused_absent')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recitations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES halaqah_days (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_surah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_surah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ayah" INTEGER NOT NULL, "faces_quarter_achieved" INTEGER NOT NULL, "evaluation" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NULL, "planned_start_surah" INTEGER NULL, "planned_start_ayah" INTEGER NULL, "planned_end_surah" INTEGER NULL, "planned_end_ayah" INTEGER NULL, CHECK (type IN ('new_memorization', 'revision')), CHECK (start_surah BETWEEN 1 AND 114), CHECK (end_surah BETWEEN 1 AND 114), CHECK (start_ayah >= 1), CHECK (end_ayah >= 1), CHECK (faces_quarter_achieved > 0), CHECK (evaluation IN ('talqin', 'excellent', 'very_good', 'good', 'acceptable', 'weak')), CHECK (error_count >= 0), CHECK ((planned_start_surah IS NULL AND planned_start_ayah IS NULL AND planned_end_surah IS NULL AND planned_end_ayah IS NULL) OR (planned_start_surah IS NOT NULL AND planned_start_ayah IS NOT NULL AND planned_end_surah IS NOT NULL AND planned_end_ayah IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (planned_start_surah IS NULL OR planned_start_surah BETWEEN 1 AND 114), CHECK (planned_end_surah IS NULL OR planned_end_surah BETWEEN 1 AND 114), CHECK (planned_start_ayah IS NULL OR planned_start_ayah >= 1), CHECK (planned_end_ayah IS NULL OR planned_end_ayah >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "support_weekly_reports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "halaqah_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES halaqahs (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "week_start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "week_end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "teacher_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "halaqah_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "template_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "approved_at_utc" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("halaqah_id", "week_start_date"), CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'approved')), CHECK (week_end_date >= week_start_date), CHECK (length(trim(teacher_name_snapshot)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(halaqah_name_snapshot)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(organization_name_snapshot)) > 0), CHECK (policy_version > 0), CHECK (template_version > 0), CHECK ((status = 'draft' AND source_fingerprint IS NULL AND approved_at_utc IS NULL) OR (status = 'approved' AND source_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(source_fingerprint)) > 0 AND approved_at_utc IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "support_weekly_report_students" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "report_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES support_weekly_reports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "support_student_number_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "student_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_juz_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "daily_plan_text_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "monthly_goal_quarter_faces_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "student_note_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "display_order_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("report_id", "source_student_id"), CHECK (length(trim(student_name_snapshot)) > 0), CHECK (current_juz_snapshot IS NULL OR current_juz_snapshot BETWEEN 1 AND 30), CHECK (support_student_number_snapshot IS NULL OR length(trim(support_student_number_snapshot)) > 0), CHECK (daily_plan_text_snapshot IS NULL OR length(trim(daily_plan_text_snapshot)) > 0), CHECK (monthly_goal_quarter_faces_snapshot > 0), CHECK (display_order_snapshot > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "support_weekly_report_days" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "report_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES support_weekly_reports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "day_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("report_id", "day_date"), CHECK (day_kind IN ('normal', 'holiday', 'missing', 'not_applicable')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "support_weekly_report_day_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "report_day_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES support_weekly_report_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "report_student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES support_weekly_report_students (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "attendance_status_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "achieved_quarter_faces" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "start_surah_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "start_ayah_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "end_surah_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "end_ayah_snapshot" INTEGER NULL, "note_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "entry_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("report_day_id", "report_student_id", "entry_order"), CHECK (attendance_status_snapshot IS NULL OR attendance_status_snapshot IN ('present', 'absent', 'excused_absent')), CHECK (achieved_quarter_faces >= 0), CHECK (entry_order > 0), CHECK ((start_surah_snapshot IS NULL AND start_ayah_snapshot IS NULL AND end_surah_snapshot IS NULL AND end_ayah_snapshot IS NULL) OR (start_surah_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND start_ayah_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND end_surah_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND end_ayah_snapshot IS NOT NULL)), CHECK (start_surah_snapshot IS NULL OR start_surah_snapshot BETWEEN 1 AND 114), CHECK (end_surah_snapshot IS NULL OR end_surah_snapshot BETWEEN 1 AND 114), CHECK (start_ayah_snapshot IS NULL OR start_ayah_snapshot >= 1), CHECK (end_ayah_snapshot IS NULL OR end_ayah_snapshot >= 1), CHECK ((start_surah_snapshot IS NULL AND achieved_quarter_faces = 0) OR (start_surah_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND achieved_quarter_faces > 0)));
